name: mo_search_businesses
description: Search the Missouri Secretary of State business-entity register by the start of an entity's name. Returns each entity's file_number (its charter number), name, entity type, locale (domestic = formed in Missouri, foreign = formed elsewhere and registered in Missouri), status and creation date. Tolerant of case, punctuation, "&" vs "and" and the legal-form spelling (Inc / Incorporated, LLC / L.L.C.): each row carries match = exact | legal_form_variant | name_prefix, ranked in that order, and hits counts only the exact and legal_form_variant rows. Fictitious-name registrations are included and marked name_kind fictitious; they are not companies. The register returns the first 20 rows of a longer list, so total_in_register says how many matched in all. Entity-level only: no individuals' names (registered agents are not returned). Includes inactive entities unless active_only is true. Pass a row's file_number to mo_get_business for detail.

name.description: Start of the entity name, e.g. "EvlarSoft".

active_only.description: Only entities in an active status. Default false (all statuses).

name: mo_get_business
description: One Missouri Secretary of State business entity by its charter number (file_number from mo_search_businesses, e.g. "LC014419805"): name, entity type, locale (domestic or foreign), status and creation date. Entity-level only: the registered agent is not returned. found is false only when the register answered and holds no such charter number.
